mainEntity.name: How much does a Land Rover Freelander 2.2 TD4 engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A rebuilt Land Rover Freelander 2.2 TD4 (224DT) engine typically costs between £3,000 and £5,000 for supply only, while reconditioned units start from £2,000.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of 224DT engine failure in a Land Rover Freelander 2.2 TD4?

acceptedAnswer.text: Owners often report white smoke from the exhaust (coolant leak), a metallic rattle on cold start (timing chain), or loss of power with the "Check Engine" light.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a 2006-2014 Land Rover Freelander 2.2 TD4?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes-clean, well-maintained Freelander 2.2 TD4 models hold strong values, typically between £3,000 and £8,000.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Land Rover Freelander 2.2 TD4 engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard supply and fit service for the Land Rover Freelander 2.2 TD4 typically takes 2 to 3 days.

mainEntity.name: Does the 224DT engine replacement retain the original ECU calibration?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes-every rebuilt or reconditioned 224DT engine supplied through EnginesMarket is fully compatible with the L359 Freelander's ECU and Terrain Response system.

mainEntity.name: Are there different power variants of the 2.2 TD4 engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes-there are three power variants of the 2.2 TD4 engine in the Freelander 2: 122hp (224DT), 150hp (eD4), and 190hp (SD4).

historyTimeline.h2: Land Rover Freelander 2.2 TD4 - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: When the 2.2L TD4 diesel engine was introduced to the Land Rover Freelander 2 (L359) in 2006, it marked a significant refinement over the previous generation's diesel options, bringing Ford-sourced Duratorq technology with improved efficiency and torque to the compact SUV.

milestones.description: 224DT (2.2L TD4), 122hp, introduced as the base diesel option for the all-new L359 Freelander, featuring Ford Duratorq technology with a revised EGR system and updated emissions controls.
DW12BTED4 (2.2L TD4), 150hp, introduced as the "eD4" efficient dynamics variant, offering improved fuel economy and lower emissions while maintaining strong torque characteristics.
SD4 (2.2L TD4), 190hp, introduced as the high-performance diesel option, featuring twin-turbocharging for enhanced power and torque delivery.

historyTimeline.closingNote: Every engine fitted to the Land Rover Freelander 2.2 TD4 is covered below, with UK rebuilt pricing and known failure points.

problems.h4: EGR Cooler Failure - Why the Land Rover Freelander 2.2 TD4 224DT Suffers Coolant Leaks
problems.rootCause: The EGR cooler is prone to internal leaks, allowing coolant to mix with exhaust gases, leading to engine contamination and potential head damage.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replacing the EGR cooler with an upgraded unit and flushing the cooling system.
repairOptions.longevity: Viable only if caught before coolant contamination spreads.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, upgraded components addressing the original failure point, 12-month warranty.
repairOptions.longevity: Necessary if coolant has already contaminated the engine or caused hydrolock.

problems.recommendation: For pre-2010 Freelander 2.2 TD4 units, a preventative EGR cooler replacement and timing chain upgrade is strongly advised to mitigate known risks. However, if coolant leaks, rattling noises, or loss of power are already present, a full rebuilt engine with upgraded internals offers the best long-term reliability and protects your significant vehicle investment.

problems.h4: Timing Chain Tensioner Wear - Why the Land Rover Freelander 2.2 TD4 224DT Suffers Rattling Noises
problems.rootCause: The timing chain tensioner design is prone to wear under high load, leading to chain rattle on cold starts and potential valve-to-piston contact if ignored.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replacing the timing chain kit with an upgraded tensioner.
repairOptions.longevity: Recommended preventative measure for pre-2010 units approaching 100k miles.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, upgraded components addressing the original failure point, 12-month warranty.
repairOptions.longevity: The right call if the chain has already jumped or secondary internal damage has occurred.
